idea-plugin.name: Version Checker
idea-plugin.description:
Shows newer stable dependency versions in your build files, and updates them with Alt+Enter or in one reviewed batch.

  • Maven: dependencies, BOMs, build plugins, version properties and the Maven wrapper.
  • Gradle: libraries, BOMs and plugins in build scripts and version catalogs, and the Gradle wrapper.
  • npm, pnpm, Yarn and Bun: dependencies in package.json, including workspaces and aliases.

Checks use your existing build configuration: Maven settings and mirrors, .npmrc and Gradle repositories. A minimum release age can hold back new releases, for example to match a repository quarantine.

Use Tools | Versions | Review Updates… to choose patch, minor or major updates for a file or the whole project. All changes apply as one undoable edit. The plugin edits declarations only; it does not change lockfiles or installed packages.
